notes: Planning harness v3: scope, feature acceptance and task design receive separate versioned context packets. Project-local memory binds validated prefixes to the full request, known API contracts and declared scenario references. Reviewed starter contracts are reused instead of model redeclaration; starter-shaped examples and concrete contract feedback keep wrappers, mutation bodies and persistence checks consistent. Static interface indexing supplies source names/hashes without importing code. New-stage content rejection no longer excludes a model from later different stages; provider/account/transport controls and call limits remain. Budget estimates use the actual stage schema, preserve the 8192 output floor and expose required/effective context on refusal. A prominent Plan feature by feature button chooses the new workflow. Diag adds four semantic guards and a stricter create-record planning probe; old probe success is not full-plan evidence. Approved plans/checks, v1/v2 drafts, routes, consent and exports remain compatible. No new dependency, extra model reviewer or live success-rate claim.
